Make rules for builds, tests, coverage, frontend assets, and cleanup.

# Purpose
This `Makefile` defines the build and test workflow for the project by disabling built-in `make` rules, setting global build flags, and declaring the main targets for binaries, libraries, tests, fuzzing, and cleanup. It collects `Local.mk` fragments from the source tree and includes them so each source area can add its own objects, headers, scripts, and test targets through shared helper macros such as `make-bin`, `make-unit-test`, and `make-fuzz-test`. It also defines generic rules for compiling C, C++, and assembly sources, generating dependency files, copying headers and example files into the build tree, and running unit, integration, script, vector, and seccomp policy tests. In addition, it manages build metadata in `$(OBJDIR)/info`, creates coverage reports with LLVM and LCOV tools, and builds the frontend assets into release-channel-specific static file sets for use by the application.
